subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram Business Bot support (business_message / business_connection updates)

question: What security and persistence model should Telegram Business personal-DM support use before implementation is resumed?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the correct behavior decides who may grant the bot access to personal chats, how long outbound Business connection authority is retained, and whether replies are automatic channel replies or a separate guarded mode.

options.title: Business support behind explicit Telegram policy
options.body: Add Business message handling only with documented, account-scoped authorization and durable connection storage that removes disabled connections before outbound injection.

options.title: Inbound-only first
options.body: Accept Business messages for observation but defer outbound `business_connection_id` replies until the security model is proven separately.

options.title: Do not support Business DMs in core
options.body: Decline the bundled Telegram plugin feature unless a plugin/API boundary can carry it outside core.

recommendation.title: Business support behind explicit Telegram policy
recommendation.body: Add Business message handling only with documented, account-scoped authorization and durable connection storage that removes disabled connections before outbound injection.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee on the prior same-scope implementation PR and has recent history on Telegram handler and update seams.
